# Grant Holloway — Wireless Network Delivery Consultant

> Independent consultant leading 4G/5G buildout, network modernization and stalled-program turnaround for carriers, OEMs and tower companies. 15+ years in wireless infrastructure; based in Charlotte, NC and working US-wide.
